encoding_preset.description: Encoding preset (ffmpeg -preset). Valid values: ultrafast, superfast, veryfast, faster, fast, medium, slow, slower, veryslow.

output_format.description: Output container format (e.g., mp4, webm, mkv).

quality_level.description: Quality preset (deprecated in newer versions; prefer CRF).

crf.description: Constant Rate Factor (0-51); lower = higher quality, 23 is default for libx264.

audio_channels.description: Number of audio channels (e.g., 1 for mono, 2 for stereo).

metadata_options.description: List of metadata key=value pairs (e.g., ['title=My Video', 'artist=Me']). Each gets assigned as FFCVT_META_1, FFCVT_META_2, etc.

exclude_patterns.description: List of shell-style glob patterns (e.g., ['*.tmp', '*_orig*']) to skip during batch conversion.

output_dir.description: Base output directory for converted files (if empty, use same dir as source).

overwrite.description: Overwrite output file if it exists. true = -y, false = -n.
